confidence.why: two-entrance model calibrated with tide gauges at both ends (Donnybrook DES, Halls Bay DES, Golden Beach BoM, Elimbah Ck BoM); mid-passage node reach (≈ km 18–30) from MSQ places (B); side creeks est.

sources: Geometry: OpenStreetMap waterways (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL)
Tides: Maritime Safety Queensland 2026 predictions (data.qld.gov.au, CC-BY 4.0) fitted offline; MSQ 2025 Tidal Planes secondary places
Gauges: Bureau of Meteorology water-level tables (7–14 day) fitted 2026-10-10
Tidal limits: OSM weirs, Copernicus GLO-90 DEM (via Open-Meteo), gauge evidence
Two-entrance blend: Mooloolaba harmonics (MSQ) for the Caloundra bar; DES Halls Bay & BoM Golden Beach gauges (data/sysg archive)

twoEnt.fit: Fitted 2026-10-15: south wave = Scarborough harmonics through Bongaree/Toorbul/Donnybrook (DES gauge); north wave = Mooloolaba harmonics through Caloundra Head/Golden Beach (BoM gauge)/Halls Bay (DES gauge); blended by a logistic weight centred at the tidal node, tuned to MSQ secondary places Hussey Ck mouth and The Skids. Check vs gauge readings (Oct 2026): Donnybrook rms 0.08 m / HL ±9 min; Halls Bay rms 0.07 m / ±14 min; Golden Beach rms 0.06 m / ±28 min; Hussey/The Skids MSQ ±13 min, ±0.02 m.
